FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN event AS T4 ON T2."XCL_001" = T4."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN major AS T3 ON T1."XCL_042" = T3."XCL_030"
INNER JOIN zip_code AS T5 ON T1."XCL_041" = T5."XCL_043"
WHERE T4."XCL_011" = 'September Meeting' AND T5."XCL_047" = 'Illinois'
